results.description:
A lonesome cowboy, his best friend with no memory… and a danger that won't let her go.

With city-girl clothes and a cowgirl's grit, Kacey Daring returns to her small Wyoming hometown hoping to outrun the threat that's been stalking her. But when a brutal attack steals her memory, the only person she remembers is the one she left behind—the cowboy whose heart she shattered.

Sawyer West has never gotten over Kacey riding out of his life without warning. He built walls to protect himself from the pain… walls that start to crumble the moment she crashes back into his world—wounded, terrified, and with no idea why she's running.

As unsettling clues surface and danger closes in, Sawyer will do anything to keep Kacey safe—even if it means pretending the past never happened and guarding his heart all over again.

But secrets don't stay buried for long… and this time, love may not be enough to protect them.

For readers who love the heartwarming romances of Debra Clopton and the suspenseful twists of Jennifer Ryan.

Her Steadfast Cowboy is book four in the Unforgettable Cowboys series—standalone stories where rugged cowboys and brave women fall hard, hold fast, and fight for love against all odds. Grab your copy today and don't miss the next book in this unforgettable series!
